notes: Implemented P0 tests from Phase 3 test plan: Section 3 (TitleManager, 39 tests/121 assertions), Section 5 (ExportManager, 15 tests/32 assertions), Section 6 (SettingsPersistence, 17 tests/55 assertions), and Section 8.2.3 (E2E Full Session, 1 test/6 assertions). Key discovery: toggleBold/toggleItalic/toggleUnderline implementation toggles ALL formatting flags (not just the target one) when the formatting object has undefined values, causing unexpected merge behavior.
